_: Notes for translators. Not a language: the app never loads this file. Keys are the same as in en.json.
app.edition.desktop: Name of the edition shown as a small tag next to the logo. One short word.
app.edition.portable: Name of the edition shown as a small tag next to the logo. One short word.
key.ctrlK: Keyboard shortcut label as printed on keyboards in your language (German: Strg K).
key.enter: Key name as printed on keyboards in your language (French: Entrée).
key.backspace: Key name as printed on keyboards in your language (German: Rücktaste).
key.delete: Key name as printed on keyboards in your language, usually abbreviated (Spanish: Supr, German: Entf).
header.scan: Verb on the main button. Keep it short: it sits next to the drive selector.
header.cancel: The main button turns into this while scanning: it stops the scan. Short.
header.scanDone: Shown after a scan. {time} is a formatted duration such as “2.8 sec”.
header.engine.mft: Name of the fast engine. MFT is the NTFS Master File Table: usually left as is.
header.engine.walk: Name of the slower engine that walks folders one by one. One short word on a small pill.
header.elevate: Button that restarts the app as administrator to use the fast engine. Short.
header.filter.placeholder: Placeholder of the search box. The part after the colon is search syntax: keep ext:, size: and age: exactly as they are.
header.theme: Tooltip of the theme button. {mode} is system, dark or light.
help.intro: Explains the search syntax. Keep OR, the minus sign and the <code> tags as they are.
tab.clean: Tab that suggests what can be deleted to recover disk space. Short.
tree.col.alloc: Column header: space really used on disk (allocated clusters), which can differ from the file size.
tree.more: Row at the end of a long folder listing that loads more rows.
map.color.age: Noun: color tiles by how long ago each file was modified.
map.style.mosaic: Visual style of the map: flat tiles separated by grout lines, like a mosaic.
map.style.relief: Visual style of the map: tiles shaded like raised cushions.
map.highlight: {label} is a category, an extension such as “.mp4” or an age range.
tip.small: A tile that groups many items too small to draw one by one.
comp.title.category: Heading of the panel that groups disk space by kind of file.
comp.noExt: Very short: shown inline in a list of extensions such as “.dll .exe no ext.”.
insp.confirmTrash: Question before moving to the Recycle Bin. Use the name of the Recycle Bin in your Windows.
attr.sparse: NTFS sparse file attribute. Use the term Windows uses in file properties.
attr.reparse: NTFS reparse point. Use the term Windows uses.
attr.hardlink: NTFS hard link. Use the term Windows uses.
clean.risk.ok: Badge on a cleanup suggestion: safe to delete. One or two words.
clean.risk.warn: Badge on a cleanup suggestion: the user should check before deleting. One or two words.
clean.risk.bad: Badge on a cleanup suggestion: Windows manages it, do not delete by hand. Short.
clean.temp.how: Path in the Windows Settings app. Use the exact names of Windows in your language, separated by ›.
clean.windowsUpdate.how: Path in the Windows Settings app. Use the exact names of Windows in your language, separated by ›.
clean.windowsOld.how: Path in the Windows Settings app. Use the exact names of Windows in your language, separated by ›.
clean.game.title: {name} is the folder name of an installed game.
phase.link: Scan phase: connecting files to their parent folders to build the tree.
guide.filter.aliases: The search keys are the same in every language. Do not translate the code samples.
engine.scan.mftFailed: {error} is a technical detail in English. Leave it as a parameter.
engine.action.failed: {error} is a Windows error message, already in the language of Windows.
readme.desktop.smartscreen: Quote the SmartScreen dialog with the exact words Windows uses in your language.
readme.options: Heading of a list of command-line options. Keep “bun.exe tesserafs.js” as is.
